name: MedleyDB: Multitrack Dataset for MIR Research
description: MedleyDB is an annotated multitrack audio dataset for music information retrieval (MIR) containing 122 multitrack musical pieces across diverse genres, providing 1,675 individual instrument and vocal stems along with melody pitch contours and instrument activation annotations.

publisher.name: Music and Audio Research Laboratory (MARL), New York University

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International
license.notes: Distributed on Zenodo under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International.

source_references.title: MedleyDB: A Multitrack Dataset for Annotation-Intensive MIR Research

verification.notes: Verified against ISMIR 2014 paper and Zenodo deposit (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.165889). Consists of 122 multitrack songs with 1,675 raw instrument stems, 108 melody-annotated tracks, and 7.2 hours of audio.

size.notes: Multitrack 44.1 kHz 16-bit WAV files, YAML metadata, and CSV pitch/instrument annotations.

citation.paper_title: MedleyDB: A Multitrack Dataset for Annotation-Intensive MIR Research
